summary.goal: Two-tier deduplication. Exact dedup: source_type + external_id uniqueness check before pipeline entry. Near dedup: after extraction, same cluster + >80% keyword overlap from same source type within 7 days is marked near_duplicate_of with repetition boost on original.

acceptance_criteria.description: Exact dedup rejects signals with matching source_type + external_id before entering the pipeline
Near dedup detects signals in the same cluster with >80% keyword overlap from the same source type within 7 days
Near-duplicate signals are marked with near_duplicate_of referencing the original signal ID
When a near-duplicate is detected, the original signal receives a repetition score boost
Exact dedup runs pre-pipeline (before any processing), near dedup runs post-extraction (after keywords are available)

steps.title: Implement exact dedup check
steps.description: Build checkExactDuplicate(sourceType, externalId) that queries storage for an existing signal with the same source_type and external_id combination. Add a unique composite index on (source_type, external_id) in the signals table. If a match is found, return the existing signal ID to indicate a duplicate. This runs before the pipeline to reject already-processed signals immediately.

steps.title: Implement near dedup detection with keyword overlap
steps.description: Build checkNearDuplicate(signal, extraction, clusterId) that: (1) queries signals in the same cluster from the same source_type created within the last 7 days, (2) for each candidate, computes keyword overlap as intersection/union of keyword sets, (3) if overlap > 0.8, returns the original signal as the near-duplicate match. Keyword comparison is case-insensitive. Returns null if no near duplicate found.

steps.title: Add near_duplicate_of marking with repetition boost
steps.description: When a near duplicate is detected: (1) mark the new signal with near_duplicate_of = originalSignalId in storage, (2) boost the original signal's repetition score factor to reflect the repeated observation, (3) the near-duplicate signal is still stored (for audit trail) but flagged so it is excluded from default cluster views and scoring aggregations.

steps.title: Integrate dedup into pipeline stages
steps.description: Wire exact dedup as a pre-pipeline gate: before any processing, check source_type + external_id and reject if duplicate. Wire near dedup as a post-extraction step: after Tier 3 extraction produces keywords and after cluster assignment, run near dedup check. Both checks integrate with the pipeline's StepProvenance tracking to record dedup decisions.
